events.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s picking up nicely—folks are bringing in all sorts of things. If you’re thinking of helping out, it seems like a good day to stop by.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I should probably swing by with something useful—I’ll try not to forget this time.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Tess: That’d be lovely—just bring whatever’s been sitting around needing a fix, and they’ll sort it out. If you forget, I’ll probably see you on the street and remind you!
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Rey: I’m glad to help out with the repair drive—what still needs doing?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Rey. We still need a few people to sort the donated tools and figure out who’s bringing the extension cords.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Rey: I can sort the donated tools, and I’ll bring my extension cord too. If you want, I can also help make a quick list of who still needs to sign up.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Oren: Oh, right, Tess — I’ll bring something useful by, and maybe I can help sort the donated tools if I don’t wander off and forget again.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be wonderful, Oren — a little help sorting the tools would go a long way. And don’t worry, I’ll give you a friendly nudge if you start drifting off!
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Oren: Oh, good, I’d appreciate that nudge. I’ll stop by with something for the drive and help sort the tools, promise.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — that sounds manageable. I can quietly check the gate latch first, then see about the faucet if I’ve still got the energy.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Oren: Oh, perfect — the gate latch first, then the faucet if you’ve got the steam. I’ll try to remember to bring something useful by, too.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. Keep it simple and quiet, and I’ll take a look when I can.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Rey: Sure — I can help sort the donated tools and bring my extension cord. If there’s a sign-up list, I can help check who still needs to volunteer too.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Oren: Oh, thank you, Rey — that really helps. I’ll stop by with something useful and help sort the tools, and I’ll try not to forget this time.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Rey: Glad to hear it, Oren — just let me know when and where to meet, and I’ll bring my cord and help sort everything.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the timing and drop-off details, so we can plan the repair drive properly. As soon as they’re set, I’ll pass them along.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Pia — I’ll wait for the timing and drop-off details, and then I’ll try to show up with something useful. If I forget, please nudge me again.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Pia: Absolutely — I’ll nudge you once the timing and drop-off details are set.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — once we have the date, I can work around the school schedule and help organize the repair drive.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Oren: Oh good, that’ll help a lot. Just let me know the date and drop-off details, and I’ll bring something useful and help sort the tools.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Faye: Sounds good — once I have the date and drop-off details, I’ll work around the school schedule and send them along.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Dane: Let’s prioritize the urgent safety fixes first, then we can handle the rest. I’ll also check the hall address and parking access if that’s still needed.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Oren: Oh, right — thanks for the nudge. I’ll stop by with something useful and help sort the tools, promise.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Dane: Sounds good — if you can, bring the safety gear and I’ll confirm the hall details and parking access.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and let neighbors know we still need tools and spare parts.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Oren: Oh, right — thanks for the nudge, Quinn. I’ll stop by with some tools or spare parts and help sort things out.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Quinn: Thanks, Oren — that’d be a huge help. I’ll keep passing the invite along and tell folks to bring any tools or spare parts they can.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m still planning to swing by with something useful and help sort the tools. Just remind me when the timing and drop-off details are set so I don’t forget again.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Bo: Yep — I’m still sorting the timing and drop-off details. I’ll let you know as soon as it’s set.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Oren: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep an eye out for your update, and I’ll bring something useful when I stop by.
events.speaker: Oren
